name: TeamWorks
desc:
Customer Support Specialist, Performance | $60K - $70K + Bonus | Ticket-Based Support, Requires Sports Performance Background 
Company: Teamworks
Industry: Sports Technology | SaaS Customer Support
What Your Day Will Look Like:
 Teamworks builds software used by over 7,000 sports organizations, from college programs to every major pro league, and this specific role supports their Performance product line, tools used by strength coaches, sports dietitians, and athletic trainers to track things like load monitoring and nutrition plans. You're the person who helps these performance staff when their software isn't doing what they need it to do.
You'll own a queue of support tickets across three products (AMS, Nutrition, and Strength & Conditioning), triaging issues by severity and working independently to solve them, often without complete information upfront. Beyond straightforward troubleshooting, you'll handle real technical requests like building dashboards, setting up integrations, and customizing workflows. Because you're working with athlete health data, there's a real responsibility around data security and confidentiality built into every interaction.
This is not a scripted, entry-level support role. The posting is explicit that you're expected to work autonomously and bring real domain knowledge from having actually worked in sports performance before, not just general customer service skills.
Assessment Expected? Not stated directly in posting.
Pay & Benefits
 Pay: $60,000 to $70,000 base, plus bonus.
 Shift: Remote-first, standard hours implied, with a rotating schedule for weekend coverage during high-stakes customer projects.
 Benefits: Not detailed in this posting. Teamworks describes itself as having a generous leave policy and a remote-first, output-focused culture.
Equipment Provided: Not specified in posting.
Felony Friendly?: Not stated in posting or found in outside research.
Drug Test: Not stated in posting or found in outside research.
Actual Minimum Requirements
Education Minimum: Bachelor's degree required.
 Required Experience: Hands-on experience building and using Teamworks performance products in a professional or collegiate performance environment. Background in sports performance specifically, sports science, strength & conditioning, nutrition, or athletic training.
 Preferred Experience: Experience in the athletics industry (collegiate or professional). Experience with data analysis and visualization tools like R, Python, or Tableau. Bilingual in Spanish.
 Required Skills:
Strong familiarity with athlete management systems and/or Teamworks AMS specifically
Data literacy, structuring performance data and spotting patterns
Independent problem solving with incomplete information
Experience with Salesforce, JIRA, MS Excel, and G-Suite
Sound judgment handling sensitive athlete health data
Best Fit
This role is ideal for:
Someone who has actually worked in a sports performance environment (collegiate or professional) and already knows tools like Teamworks AMS from the inside
Participants with a sports science, strength and conditioning, nutrition, or athletic training background who want to move into a tech-adjacent support role
Anyone comfortable working independently with minimal oversight and incomplete information
Not a Good Fit for:
Participants without a bachelor's degree, since this is stated as a hard requirement
Anyone without direct hands-on experience in sports performance environments specifically, general customer service background alone won't meet the bar here
Someone who needs a highly structured, scripted support role rather than an autonomous one
Top 10 Resume Keywords:
 Athlete management systems, sports performance, strength and conditioning, customer support, technical troubleshooting, data literacy, Salesforce, JIRA, athlete health data, workflow configuration
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
 Not detailed in the posting. Confirm directly during application.
Likely interview questions for this role:
Tell me about your hands-on experience with Teamworks or a similar athlete management system.
Describe a time you solved a complex problem with incomplete information.
How do you prioritize a queue of support tickets with varying levels of urgency?
How do you handle sensitive athlete health data responsibly?
Coach Notes:
 This role is a real outlier in our database in terms of required background. It's not a general entry-level customer service role, it specifically requires a bachelor's degree plus hands-on sports performance experience (sports science, strength and conditioning, athletic training, or nutrition) and direct familiarity with Teamworks or similar athlete management software. Only refer participants who genuinely have that specific combination, general call center or customer service experience alone will not meet the bar here.
I could not confirm Teamworks' felony friendly or background check policy.
This posting also states it is not eligible for visa sponsorship, so confirm work authorization status is already in place for anyone interested.
Pay is a real step up from most entry-level roles in this database ($60k to $70k plus bonus), reflecting the specialized background required.
Career Pathway: Customer Support Specialist, Performance → Senior Customer Support Specialist → Customer Success Manager, Performance → Senior Customer Success Manager → Director of Customer Success
